summary: Trump issued an explicit 'deal or destruction' ultimatum to Iran after a three-hour meeting with its delegation at the UN General Assembly, threatening to strike the fortified Pickaxe Mountain facility. Iranian air defenses activated repeatedly in Tabriz overnight, while Iraq enforced a ban on Iranian airlines. Saudi airstrikes hit multiple districts in Yemen's Saada governorate as the UK pledged aerial refueling support.
key_points: Trump told regional leaders the U.S. may have to 'blow up Pickaxe Mountain' after a three-hour meeting with Iranian officials that he called 'very good.' (Source: @VahidOnline/78492, @New_security8200/203893, @SharghDaily/185229)
Iran's air defense systems engaged multiple times overnight in Tabriz, indicating heightened alert posture. (Source: @kianmeli1/92371)
Iraq began enforcing a flight ban on Iranian airlines, drawing condemnation from the Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada militia. (Source: @shin_persian/10345, @naya_foriraq/91282)

Saudi warplanes struck Maran, Haydan, and Al-Zahir districts in Saada, Yemen, with missiles and drones; the UK will provide RAF aerial refueling. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394076, @rasedal3ado138e/394075, @presstv/207816)
Fourteen Israeli activists from 'Halutzei HaBashan' crossed into Syria near Aloni HaBashan; IDF forces intercepted and returned them to Israel. (Source: @New_security8200/203891, @idf_telegram/25174)
Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West pipeline after a drone attack from Iraqi territory; oil exports from Yanbu may resume by late Tuesday. (Source: @mamlekate/104582)
Ben-Gvir announced a strategic plan to encourage 'voluntary migration' from Gaza and the West Bank. (Source: @amitsegal/65064)
Rubio stated 60-70% of pre-crisis oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz has resumed and will increase. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81300)

points: Trump held a three-hour meeting with an Iranian delegation at the UNGA, called it 'very good,' and declared 'either deal or destruction,' explicitly threatening to strike Pickaxe Mountain (Kuh-e Kolang) if necessary. (Source: @VahidOnline/78492, @New_security8200/203893, @SharghDaily/185229)
Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi met Trump envoy Witkoff on the UNGA sidelines at U.S. insistence; Iran communicated its 'decisive positions' during the encounter. (Source: @presstv/207824)
Air defense systems activated multiple times overnight in Tabriz, signaling a heightened alert posture amid U.S. strike threats. (Source: @kianmeli1/92371)
Iraq enforced a ban on Iranian airlines' flights, prompting Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada to liken the move to 'preventing water from Hussein's family.' (Source: @shin_persian/10345, @naya_foriraq/91282)
Rubio reported that 60-70% of the oil flow that previously transited the Strait of Hormuz has resumed and will increase further. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81300)
The New York Post reported Iran is recruiting 12-year-old boys for 'Ethar' martyrdom-seeking units. (Source: @kianmeli1/92368)
Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters dismissed Trump's threats as domestic propaganda, vowing 'stronger, more destructive, unexpected strikes' against aggressors. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91293)
Ben-Gvir announced a strategic plan to encourage 'voluntary migration' from Gaza and the West Bank (Judea and Samaria). (Source: @amitsegal/65064)

Fourteen Israeli activists from the 'Halutzei HaBashan' group crossed the border into Syria near Aloni HaBashan; IDF forces intercepted them and returned them to Israel for police processing. (Source: @New_security8200/203891, @idf_telegram/25174)
IDF arrested two suspects after detecting suspicious movement on the eastern border in the Jordan Valley sector; they were transferred to security forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/25175)
The Israeli delegation walked out of the UNGA hall during Turkish President Erdogan's speech. (Source: @presstv/207817)
The government extended the home front emergency declaration until October 6. (Source: @New_security8200/203888)
Lieberman and Eisenkot met to discuss 'bloc strategic coordination.' (Source: @amitsegal/65069)

Police and Shin Bet indicted a 19-year-old from Segev Shalom for incitement to terror and Hamas identification via social media posts containing October 7 footage and calls for violence. (Source: @New_security8200/203890)
Ben-Gvir's voluntary migration plan explicitly targets both Gaza and the West Bank (Judea and Samaria). (Source: @amitsegal/65064)
Macron at UNGA condemned daily violations in the West Bank, noted Hamas never operated there, and called Palestinian right to exist a prerequisite for Israeli security. (Source: @asafroz/53675)
A Negev resident was arrested for sharing Hamas-affiliated extremist content including October 7 footage, praise for militants, and explicit calls for violence. (Source: @New_security8200/203890)
No direct combat reports from Gaza appear in the provided messages.
Israeli airstrikes hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon in two separate strikes. (Source: @redlinkleb/44414, @redlinkleb/44413)
Artillery shelling was reported on Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/44439)
A Lebanese girl's testimony describes host community behavior toward displaced persons from South Lebanon. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81295)
Fourteen Israeli activists crossed into Syria near Aloni HaBashan; IDF intercepted and returned them. (Source: @New_security8200/203891, @idf_telegram/25174)
Iraq enforced a ban on Iranian airlines, drawing condemnation from the Iraqi militia Kataib Sayyid al-Shuhada. (Source: @shin_persian/10345, @naya_foriraq/91282)
Saudi Arabia restarted its East-West pipeline after a drone attack launched from Iraqi territory; oil exports from Yanbu on the Red Sea may resume by late Tuesday. (Source: @mamlekate/104582)
Putin held a phone call with Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. (Source: @asafroz/53661)
Saudi warplanes struck multiple districts in Saada, Yemen (Maran, Haydan, Al-Zahir) with missiles and drones. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394076, @rasedal3ado138e/394075)
The UK Royal Air Force will provide aerial refueling support for Saudi warplanes operating in Yemen. (Source: @presstv/207816)
Saudi East-West pipeline resumed operations after an Iraqi drone attack; Yanbu exports may restart Tuesday. (Source: @mamlekate/104582)
Macron and Trump agreed to cooperate on energy security, protect vital Middle East infrastructure, and ensure freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/78478)
The European troika (France, Germany, UK) plus five aligned nations reiterated calls for freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @SharghDaily/185222)
Rubio stated 60-70% of oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz has been restored and will increase. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81300)
